test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A and B working together can finish a piece of work in 8 days while B alone can do it in 24 days. In how many days can A alone finish the work?
solution: Given: A and B working together can finish a piece of work in 8 days while B alone can do it in 24 days. Concept used: Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)
